title: Exec staff meeting prep - Mar 3 2026
body:
Goal: align on top risks for the next 90 days, finalize dedicated capacity commit ask, and confirm cross-org owners for the reliability playbook rollout.

Quick notes / context (scratchpad):
- Last week exec asked for clearer cost vs. latency tradeoff for Hosted API (esp high-throughput customers). Need 1 slide + 2 data points.
- Dedicated pipeline: legal needs final SOW by 3/15 to hit mid-April onboarding. We have open question about burst pricing model.
- Private deployments: compliance review flagged KMS/HSM integration docs missing — S&C to produce checklist.
- Incidents: SRE reported 3 small scaling incidents in Feb due to slow KV cache eviction on v0.9.1 runtime. Patch queued but need canary plan.

Agenda (30 mins):
1) 5m — Quick status (CEO)
2) 10m — Dedicated capacity commit ask (Product + Sales) — decision: approve tiered commit + burst option?
3) 7m — Reliability hotspots & canary plan (SRE) — decision: approve immediate patch canary and rollback triggers
4) 5m — Compliance / Private deploy checklist (Security) — decision: approve doc release timeline
5) 3m — AOB / action item review

Talking points / prep per owner: 
- Marcus (Product / Dedicated): bring 2-scenario ask: (A) 3mo reserved at $X/month with burst at +25% rate; (B) 6mo reserved with smaller per-token. Show revenue runway and risk if we decline. Have legal timeline.
- Priya (Sales): highlight one-to-two anchor customers who will convert if commit terms exist (names redacted in doc). Need clear ask: is sales allowed to offer 10% discount for first-year?
- Jonah (SRE): show root cause for Feb incidents: heavy prefix cache churn (social-crawler workload), KV eviction threshold mis-tuned on multi-tenant queues. Proposed fix: adjust eviction policy + rolling restart + traffic shaping for canary (target 5% traffic on dedicated pool). Need sign-off on rollback thresholds (latency > 3x baseline OR error rate > 0.5%).
- Priya K (Security): list of missing KMS integration docs, expected completion 3/10 if headcount approves 0.2 FTE from infra. If not approved, propose temporary mitigation: allow 3rd-party-managed keys (not ideal).

Data asks / slides to bring (owners):
- Cost/latency: 2 data points: (1) 95th p99 latency delta between quantized and full-precision for typical seq len 128 (runtime team) — Marcus
- Unit economics: predicted token-run cost for high-throughput customer at current batch settings vs optimized (optimize team) — Finance & Product
- Incident timeline: one-pager with impact and proposed canary checklist (SRE) — Jonah

Open questions (to resolve in meeting or after):
- Do we endorse burst pricing? how to structure delta so sales can offer without legal sign-off each time? (Marcus + Legal)
- Do we prioritize KMS docs or hire 0.2 FTE resource from infra? cost tradeoff? (Priya K + Finance)
- Canary gating: duration and rollback windows — is 24h enough? need ops opinion.

Decisions we need from execs: 
- Approve Dedicated commit ask scenario (A or B) and discount guardrails for Sales
- Approve SRE canary plan + rollback thresholds
- Approve timeline for KMS docs (3/10) or temporary mitigations

Meeting logistics / personal notes: 
- Keep it tight — default to 3 options max per decision so we can vote quickly.
- If time runs short, push the Dedicated pricing decision to follow-up with written sign-off (preferred: capture votes in doc).
- Bring crisp slides only — 1 slide per agenda item.

Draft opener (what I will say):
"We have three items that materially impact our ability to scale: revenue (Dedicated commits), reliability (canary for runtime fix), and compliance (KMS docs). I want us to leave with clear owners and dates so engineering can move without exec re-check each step."

Follow-up / rough action list I'm tracking (scratchy):
- produce 1-slide cost vs latency (runtime + optimize) — Marcus (due 3/2)
- finalize Dedicated ask doc + legal SOW bullet points — Marcus + Legal (due 3/10)
- confirm anchor-customer list & allowable discount guardrails — Priya (due 3/2)
- SRE canary checklist + rollback triggers + schedule — Jonah (due 3/4)
- KMS integration checklist draft — Priya K (due 3/10)
- Capture exec votes in shared confluence page after meeting — me (Ava) (due 3/5)

Tone / personal reminders: 
- Call out risk in plain language (customer churn, revenue impact). Execs respond better to tradeoffs not technical detail.
- If legal needs to be looped, cc Noah from legal only on final doc (avoid premature threads).

Notes to self (post-meeting follow ups):
- If Dedicated ask approved, schedule handoff meeting with Sales ops to set up billing SKUs and internal comms.
- Ensure SRE has an on-call playbook update post-canary.
- Add KMS checklist to Product security milestone for Q2 planning.

---

This is a working scratchpad — share with Marcus/Priya/Jonah ahead of sync so they can add any missing data points.
action_items: Marcus + Legal: finalize Dedicated ask & SOW bullets (due 2026-03-10)
Priya: confirm anchor-customer list & discount guardrails (due 2026-03-02)
Jonah: SRE canary checklist + rollback triggers + schedule (due 2026-03-04)
Priya K: KMS integration checklist draft (due 2026-03-10)
Ava (me): capture exec votes in confluence after meeting (due 2026-03-05)
